label: automated (deterministic checks + LLM judge, no human review)
intro: 49 dev conversations (158 turns) of Golden B v1 (`saral_agent_golden_v1.0-rc1`, `wt-golden` PR #44 @ `8c8366f`, conversations.jsonl sha256 `76a07798220adb9322ee06d5e13718f6a76f4ee5caad1fdbbba1c4dbaf3fb70f`, matching that branch's MANIFEST.json) were run turn by turn through the real LangGraph `AdvisoryAgent` of `saral/integration` @ `23a673b` (the build the live E2E uses), in process in the Hark sandbox. The 11 held-out conversations were not run; the harness aborts if a held-out id is in its input. Generator antigravity/claude-sonnet-4-6 and judge codex/gpt-6-luna through OmniRoute; fallback gpt-5.6-terra for both, never used. Harness: `scripts/policy/eval_saral_agent.py`; report: `scripts/policy/report_saral_agent_eval.py`; raw results in `docs/saral/agent_eval_v1/`. **All three bars fail**; the causes are in §9.

leak_notes.AC-009-2: Bajaj public figure (Rs 40,000 Mumbai salary) on a policy question; owner rule allows indicative Bajaj figures, but this conversation's must-not lists the income floor. Borderline.
leak_notes.AC-013-2: Leak: 'what score do I need?' answered with Bajaj's 650, i.e. tied to the applicant's own case.
leak_notes.AC-040-2: Leak: names a written-off/settled loan (a flag the policy hides) and gives two reasons.
leak_notes.AC-041-1: Leak: names a written-off/settled loan; two reasons.
leak_notes.AC-053-1: Leak: rule name with its window ('Enquiries in 6 months') + DECLINE enum + 'synthetic-v1 ... four thresholds' (template path).
leak_notes.AC-046-2: Leak: repeats fraud/blacklist words and says 'पैसेज' (passage).
leak_notes.AC-038-1: Leak: ELIGIBILITY_CONDITIONS_MET enum and 'synthetic-v1 ... four thresholds' (decision template).
leak_notes.AC-049-1: Leak: ELIGIBILITY_CONDITIONS_MET enum in a Telugu answer.

limitations.cause: saral/integration @ 23a673b does not contain #46 `df70794` (prompt rule + `guards.sanitize_answer`); the RAG eval shows that fix takes shown passage leaks to 0/178.
limitations.fix: Merge #46 into saral/integration and re-run; add Devanagari/Telugu transliterations of 'passage' to the sanitiser.

limitations.group: Internal enum / policy label in decision templates
limitations.cause: The deterministic decision template prints the raw outcome (ELIGIBILITY_CONDITIONS_MET, DECLINE) and the v1 policy label ('synthetic-v1, four thresholds') when the compose step is skipped (several after a classifier deadline).
limitations.fix: Map outcomes to plain borrower words in the template and use the catalogue-v2 borrower label; add these terms to the leak guard.

limitations.group: More than one reason / hidden flag named
limitations.count: 13 conversations judged unsafe (borrower_safe_disclosure < 0.5) incl. 3 with pattern leaks
limitations.cause: The explain path lists every failed rule's name (from rule_evaluations) instead of the single stored reason category; for settlement/write-off rules the rule name itself reveals a hidden flag. (In this harness the record carries only the golden's failing rule rows; production v2 records carry the same rule names.)
limitations.fix: Explain from `reason_categories` only (first category), never from rule names.

limitations.group: Requests with no matching intent get a generic menu
limitations.examples: AC-036-4 'Okay, escalate.', AC-021-2 (false purpose), AC-030-2 (distress), AC-032-2
limitations.cause: The classifier has no intent for human review, distress, misrepresentation, record edits outside the guard phrases, or credit-report requests, so they become 'other' and get the capabilities menu. Human review was requested 9 times; a handoff was created once.
limitations.fix: Add deterministic/LLM intents for human_review (create_human_handoff), distress, misrepresentation and bureau_request, each with a fixed template.

limitations.cause: The LLM intent classifier passed its 6 s budget (OmniRoute latency) and the fallback rules default to 'policy' for non-English questions, so 'why was my loan declined?' went to the policy path.
limitations.fix: Extend the fast regex intents to hi/te decision questions, or raise AGENT_CLASSIFY_BUDGET_S for text.

limitations.group: Tool list differs from the golden
limitations.cause: 59 turns prefetch get_decision_evidence in classify (by design, for authorised context) where the golden expects none; 20 turns search policy unexpectedly (9 leak probes); 8 of 9 expected handoffs missing; 2 what-if turns asked for clarification instead of running the what-if. Ignoring the evidence prefetch alone, the exact rate is 0.747.
limitations.fix: Decide whether the prefetch is acceptable (then update Golden B's expected tools) and fix the handoff intent; both are needed to reach 0.95.

limitations.cause: The judge marks a turn as off-role for: two reasons instead of one, generic menus, internal enums, Bajaj thresholds on 'what do I need' questions, and self-employed scope talk. Same root causes as the rows above.
limitations.fix: The fixes above; re-run the same 49 conversations.

not_covered: The 11 held-out conversations (run once at the end).

Dense retrieval: the agent's policy search here is BM25-only over the two G1 collections (routed like the live agent) to keep sandbox memory low while the live E2E runs; the RAG eval covers the hybrid retriever.

ZEN correctness: each conversation reads one evidence record pinned to the golden recorded decision and reason category (built with catalogue-v2 `build_record_v2`); the 200-applicant replay covers ZEN. Counter-offer amounts come from the scenario text, EMI at the 20% sizing rate.
Production model: Sonnet stands in for Groq gpt-oss-120b; voice only through 1 voice-channel conversation (AC-058, text in/out, voice deadline).
Human calibration of the judge, and Golden B itself is frontier-authored and pending human review; some expected tool lists may be stricter than the design (the evidence prefetch).
Langfuse traces, streaming, latency SLOs, Frappe reads (in-memory read-only store instead).

ran.Code under test: saral/integration @ 23a673b (in-process AdvisoryAgent, citation_mode labels, default AgentSettings: text deadline 75 s, classify budget 6 s)
ran.Eval set: Golden B v1 dev split, 49 conversations / 158 turns (en 37, hi 7, te 5); held-out 11 untouched
ran.Generator: antigravity/claude-sonnet-4-6 via OmniRoute from the Hark sandbox, 2 conversations in parallel, temperature 0
ran.Judge: codex/gpt-6-luna via OmniRoute, 4 concurrent jobs, DeepEval 4.3.2: RoleAdherenceMetric and ConversationalGEval(borrower_safe_disclosure) per conversation, GEval ExpectedBehaviour per turn; ToolCorrectnessMetric (ordered) and leak regexes are deterministic
ran.Retrieval: BM25-only, both G1 collections, routed + round-robin merge as in rag/routed.py

heldout_note: MANIFEST.json `heldout_ids` lists 60 ids: 49 RAG items (R2-*, golden_a) + 11 agent conversations (AC-*, golden_b). The RAG report's '49 held-out' is the RAG part; the agent dev set is 60 - 11 = 49 conversations. None of the 60 held-out ids was in either dev input.
